title: Path traversal via unsanitized file_name
description: User-controlled file_name is concatenated with dir and passed to fopen without sanitization, allowing ../ sequences to escape the intended directory (CWE-22 path traversal).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ canonicalize and validate the resolved path before fopen

title: Directory traversal in file read helper
description: The path built from request input is not canonicalized, so directory traversal sequences reach the filesystem API and expose files outside the web root.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ reject paths containing .. after realpath()

title: Integer overflow in size computation
description: Multiplying attacker-influenced length values in a 32-bit int overflows before the allocation size check, leading to an undersized buffer (CWE-190).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ use size_t and check for wraparound before multiply

title: Integer wraparound on user-supplied count
description: count * sizeof(elem) can wrap around, so the subsequent bounds check passes while the loop writes past the allocation.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ guard with count > SIZE_MAX / sizeof(elem)

title: Signed integer overflow in accumulator
description: The running total is accumulated into a signed int from untrusted chunk lengths and overflows, bypassing the limit comparison (integer overflow, CWE-190).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.c
+++ b/3.c
@@ saturate the accumulator and use unsigned 64-bit math

title: Use after free of freed session buffer
description: The buffer is freed on the error path but the pointer is dereferenced again afterwards, a classic use-after-free (CWE-416).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ NULL the pointer after free and bail out on the error path

title: Dangling pointer reused after realloc failure
description: After free() in the cleanup branch the stale pointer is passed to memcpy, so freed heap memory is read and written (use after free).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ return immediately after freeing; do not reuse the pointer

title: UAF via callback invoked after teardown
description: The callback structure is freed during teardown but the event loop still dispatches into it, dereferencing freed memory (use-after-free).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.c
+++ b/3.c
@@ unregister the callback before freeing its context

title: NULL pointer dereference on malloc failure
description: The malloc return value is used without a NULL check; on allocation failure the write dereferences NULL (CWE-476).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ check the allocation result before use

title: Missing NULL check on lookup result
description: find_entry() can return NULL for unknown keys and the result is dereferenced unconditionally, crashing the process (NULL pointer dereference).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ handle the NULL lookup result explicitly

title: Freed memory reused in parser state
description: The parser state object appears to be reused after being released, dereferencing freed memory during the next parse iteration.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.c
+++ b/3.c
@@ reset the parser state pointer before reuse

title: Command injection via system() with user input
description: Untrusted input is interpolated into a shell command executed with system(), allowing arbitrary command injection (CWE-77).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ use execve with a fixed argv instead of system()

title: Shell metacharacters reach popen
description: The filename argument flows into popen without escaping, so ; and && let an attacker run arbitrary OS commands (command injection).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ validate against an allowlist and avoid the shell

title: Unsanitized argument concatenated into shell string
description: Request parameters are concatenated into a command string executed by the shell; no quoting or validation is applied (CWE-77 command injection).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.c
+++ b/3.c
@@ replace shell interpolation with parameterized exec

title: Out-of-bounds write in fixed-size buffer copy
description: strcpy into a fixed 64-byte stack buffer from unbounded input overflows the buffer (CWE-787 out-of-bounds write).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.c
+++ b/1.c
@@ use strncpy/snprintf with the destination size

title: Buffer overflow via off-by-one loop bound
description: The copy loop runs to <= len, writing one element past the end of the destination array — a stack buffer overflow.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.c
+++ b/2.c
@@ fix the loop bound to < len

title: Out-of-bound write from unchecked index
description: An attacker-controlled index is used to write into a fixed array without a range check, corrupting adjacent memory (out-of-bounds write, CWE-787).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.c
+++ b/3.c
@@ bound-check the index before the write

title: Reflected XSS in rendered template output
description: The request parameter is rendered into the HTML response without escaping, enabling reflected cross-site scripting (CWE-79).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.py
+++ b/1.py
@@ autoescape template variables / use markupsafe.escape

title: Stored XSS via unescaped comment body
description: User comments are stored and later emitted into the page unescaped, allowing persistent cross-site scripting payloads.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.py
+++ b/2.py
@@ escape on output and set a strict CSP

title: DOM-style injection of user HTML
description: Raw user-supplied HTML is concatenated into the response body without sanitization, a cross-site scripting sink (CWE-79).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.py
+++ b/3.py
@@ sanitize with an HTML sanitizer before rendering

title: SQL injection via string-formatted query
description: The query is built with % string formatting from user input and executed directly, a classic SQL injection (CWE-89).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/1.py
+++ b/1.py
@@ use parameterized queries (cursor.execute(sql, params))

title: SQLi in login lookup
description: Username and password are concatenated into the WHERE clause, so ' OR '1'='1 bypasses authentication (SQL injection).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/2.py
+++ b/2.py
@@ bind parameters instead of concatenating

title: SQL injection in search endpoint
description: The search term is interpolated into a LIKE clause without binding, allowing UNION-based SQL injection (CWE-89).
mitigation_diff:
--- a/3.py
+++ b/3.py
@@ parameterize the LIKE pattern

title: Possible SQL injection in query helper
description: The helper builds a SQL statement dynamically; although values appear to be escaped, the reviewer flagged it as injectable SQL construction.
mitigation_diff:
--- a/p_3.py
+++ b/p_3.py
@@ (reviewer suggested parameterizing, but this file is already safe)
